citations.claim: at first violating step controller applied 6.5 force; body accelerated to cited speed
body started at rest so force came from controller not prior motion

explanation: Controller with kp=100, fmax=5, noise=1 commands 6.5 at step 1, exceeding fmax. Likely cause: seeded sensor noise is added to the velocity-error force after the fmax clamp (or scales the command) without re-clamping, so noisy command exceeds limit.
vision_note: The red controller body remains on the left side far from the green waypoint in the upper right. Between step 0 and step 1 it shows almost no visible movement toward the target.
